input.rationale: Customer is locked into a minimum monthly fee (Monthly Base Fee) payable in advance (p0149) for an eight-year Term (p0049), must obtain all bundled Services from M&I "during the Term" (p0183), and can exit only by paying a percentage of Estimated Remaining Value measured off that minimum (p0039). That is a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction right and a penalty-style exit, which fails every fallback element (12-month commitment, 30 days' notice reduction, true-up rather than penalty). Because deleting the minimum outright would require collateral rewrites to the payment, bundling and termination-fee machinery, we target the fallback: a short new Section 8.1A capping the commitment at the then-current twelve-month period, permitting reduction on 30 days' notice and trueing up any shortfall, with a conforming edit to the Section 10.3.A sourcing period so the reduction right is not contradicted.

mappings.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.

proposal.summary: Limit the Monthly Base Fee minimum commitment to the current 12-month period, allow reduction on 30 days' notice, and true-up any shortfall instead of a penalty.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take an eight-year take-or-pay minimum whose only exit is a percentage of Estimated Remaining Value, so we limited the minimum monthly fee commitment to the then-current twelve-month period, added a 30 days' notice reduction right, and replaced any shortfall charge with a true-up. Our preferred position is no minimum commitment at all, but this fallback is acceptable.

ops.text: Minimum Commitment. Customer's minimum monthly fee commitment (including the Monthly Base Fee) is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term, and Customer may reduce such commitment upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to M&I. If Customer's actual usage-based charges for such period are less than the committed amount, Customer shall pay the difference as a true-up, and no penalty or shortfall charge shall apply.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
ops.newText: Customer agrees that, during the then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term, and subject to Customer's reduction right in Section 8.1A, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
